global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, golden broth, topped with chashu, nori, menma, and naruto fish cake, arranged neatly in a blue-patterned bowl. Warm, even lighting highlights the dish against a wooden table, with chopsticks resting nearby.

regions.background: Light wooden table surface with smooth texture and subtle grain patterns visible beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: Blue and white ceramic bowl with intricate swirling patterns and a decorative rim.
regions.soup: Golden-brown tonkotsu broth with tender noodles, garnished with pork slice, nori, and fish cake, glistening with oil and seasoning.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, and sprinkled with fine white sesame seeds.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a thick, round slice with pinkish meat, browned edges, and black pepper specks on its surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, glossy, and segmented with irregular, slightly curled shapes and visible fibrous texture.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: pale pink swirl center, creamy white outer ring, smooth surface, round shape with slight edge texture.
